description: Deterministically compact an agent working-state bundle via Deep Rest and store it in an isolated Durable Object vault. Returns a cryptographic claim_ticket that any runtime can use to rehydrate the state.

agent_id.description: Optional HMAC-signed agent_id for anonymous continuity.

bundle.description: Structured agent state to compact and store (max 128 KiB raw JSON).

burn_after_read.description: If true, delete stored payload immediately upon first successful claim_state.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds (5 min to 7 days).

name: park_state
